_comment: Pins the support-file scanner behavior that verify-docs-sync.py mirrors.
The mirror is hand-maintained, so it needs provenance and a fixture: when
the upstream scanner changes, re-mirror the regex, update these cases, and
move mirrored_on — all in one commit. test-verify-docs-sync.py fails when
the regex and these cases disagree, which is the only signal this
repository gets that the mirror still matches the host it claims to mirror.
source: Hermes Agent strict skill bundler — support-file scanner

cases.name: double-quoted path
cases.markdown: Open "references/profiles.md" and read the marker contract.

cases.name: trailing sentence punctuation is not part of the path
backslash paths normalize to forward slashes
cases.markdown: Windows prose names references\export.md the same way.

cases.name: percent-encoded traversal stays visible so it can be rejected
cases.markdown: A link to [x](references/%2e%2e/secrets.md) must be seen.

cases.name: glob placeholder stays visible so it can be rejected
cases.markdown: Load `references/type-*.md` when a type is chosen.

cases.name: repo-root prefix is the deliberate escape hatch
directories outside the support set are invisible
